falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes above 5,600 on any single day within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A decisive breakout above the August 2024 consolidation highs would invalidate the bottom_2024_aug pattern match, as that pattern resolved with lower lows after a failed rally; this would signal continuation rather than reversal

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes below 12.00 for 3 consecutive trading days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Sustained VIX compression to pre-correction complacency levels would disprove the bottoming thesis, as August 2024-style bottoms require elevated volatility that persists through the basing process; this would indicate the market never feared enough to form a durable low

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield breaks above 4.50% and holds above that level for 5 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A renewed bond selloff/rates spike would invalidate the pattern match because the August 2024 bottom coincided with rates peaking and reversing lower; sustained higher rates would indicate a different macro regime (persistent inflation/risk) rather than the rate-relief bottoming template

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
